messages:
Alyssa: Hey team — kicking off onboarding for Vesper Health (trial account). Goal: 30-day activation with search integration and usage baseline for renewal signal. Posting a compact checklist + ask for owners. Main blockers we anticipate: SSO cert turnaround, data schema alignment, and initial traffic shaping.

Ravi: I can own SSO. ETA request to Vesper IT today. Will flag if cert + metadata not in 48h. :thumbsup:

Maya: I'll take data schema mapping and sandbox ingestion. Need sample payloads — @Alyssa can you confirm sampler set and send to maya@redwood.com? :eyes:

Jules: I'll handle the onboarding enablement session and docs. Propose a 45-min workshop Day 3. Who should attend from their side?

Alyssa: @Maya — sent sample payloads link: https://files.redwood.internal/vesper/samples (note: redwood S3 shortlink). @Jules good call — ask for their PM + infra lead.

Samir: I'll own cost/limits guardrails and quota setup on Dedicated trial. Need expected QPS and token estimates. If we don't get numbers, I'll set conservative caps and enable burst for Day 1. :warning:

Nora: Capturing renewal risk items: if we miss activation by Day 30 or SSO pushed >10d, classify as High risk for renewal outreach. Also, ask Success to capture NPS at Day 14.

Alyssa: Checklist (compact):
```
1) Day 0: Access & creds (owner: Alyssa)
2) Day 1-3: Sandbox ingest + schema map (owner: Maya)
3) Day 3: Enablement workshop (owner: Jules)
4) Day 5-10: SSO validation + smoke tests (owner: Ravi)
5) Day 7-14: Perf baseline & quota tuning (owner: Samir)
6) Day 14: NPS pulse & quality check (owner: Nora)
7) Day 21-30: Go/No-go + renewal signal (owner: Alyssa)
```

Alyssa: Quick asks: everyone add a 30-min weekly sync on your calendar (recurring until Day 30). I'll send invites.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Vesper Onboarding - Weekly Sync" — Wednesdays 10:00-10:30 PT, invitees: Alyssa, Ravi, Maya, Jules, Samir, Nora.

Ravi: Noted. If their SSO vendor needs our cert chain in a specific format we might need help from eng-security — raising now.

Maya: For schema gaps — if they only send partial metadata we'll map fields and create a shim layer, but that adds ~3 dev days. Noted as a risk.

Jules: Enablement agenda draft: 1) Goals & success criteria 2) Integration walkthrough 3) Ops & alerts 4) Q&A. I'll post slides by EOD tomorrow.

Samir: For quotas I propose initial cap: 20 RPS, 3e6 tokens/day. Can bump after Day 3 with perf numbers. Agree?

Nora: Agree to thresholds. Also adding success criteria doc snippet: "Activation = search results used in prod traffic >= 100 queries/day AND avg latency < 600ms for 90th pct by Day 30."

Alyssa: Perfect. I'll update the shared onboarding tracker and tag owners. If anyone hits a blocker please ping #customer-success-ops and drop a quick status update. :rocket:
